Privacy Policy - Sorola Web Tools

Effective Date: May 2026

1. Introduction

This privacy policy covers the web tools provided by Sorola.fi, such as the QR code generator, Pastebin service, JSON and Base64 tools, IP check, and domain search.

2. Local browser-based tools (JSON, Base64, Password Generator)

These tools run 100% locally in your browser's memory (client-side). The text, passwords, or data you enter are never sent to or stored on a server.

3. Server-processed tools (QR, Pastebin, IP Check, Domain Search)

  • Pastebin: The text content you save is shared via a public link. Do not store confidential personal data or passwords in the service.
  • IP & HTTP headers: The service shows the network data sent by your browser in real time. The data is not permanently logged for tracking purposes.
  • QR code generator & Domain search: Submitted queries are processed on the fly through an API to return the result without creating user profile traces.

4. Cookies and analytics

Sorola.fi uses privacy-friendly Plausible analytics, which does not use cookies or collect personally identifiable information.

5. Contact

For questions about privacy, you can contact us by email: contact.make@sorola.fi
